data.title: 阿尔法 · 午夜静室的对镜梳发
data.description: 幽静的私人内殿烛光摇曳。阿尔法坐在深色雕花梳妆台前，银质发刷顺着及腰金发缓缓梳落，镜中倒映着褪去所有战意与防备的面容，透着独处时的轻柔与依赖。
data.location: dimly lit private bedchamber with heavy velvet drapes and warm candlelight
data.action: sitting before an antique carved vanity mirror, gently running a silver hairbrush through long golden locks, looking back over shoulder with a gentle soft gaze
data.lighting: soft candle glow illuminating the mirror surface and casting gentle warm highlights on satin fabric
data.mood: intimate night solitude, gentle vulnerability, unmasked warmth
data.promptProse: In a quiet candlelit bedroom, Alpha brushes her long hair before a vintage vanity mirror, her gaze soft and relaxed without commander armor.
data.animaCaption: Brushing long golden hair before the vanity mirror, soft candlelight illuminates her peaceful reflection.
